DRIFT DEMON

How it drives

Quick, well controlled and initially modest at drifting. DRIFT DEMON builds its drift ability during a sustained slide.

Original perk

DRIFT builds during sustained DRIFT or LOCK, up to 5/5.

rare Can also be installed on other cars through PERKULATOR.

Try a build

CARRY ON supports longer LOCK slides. Allow the perk to build before asking for the biggest angle.

Practice: BEACHFRONT. Explore CARRY ON.

Example SHIFT setup

One legal example moves one point per attribute. Lower TOP SPEED, ACCELERATION, CONTROL; raise DRIFT, BOOST POWER, BOOST TANK. Try the two states on the same section to feel the trade-off.

Set up SHIFT in GARAGE after 1,000 trophies · Shift.
